notes.title: Super Life "Franchise Lord" Update
notes.notes:
Super Life continues in my new game 'Franchise Lord'! A franchise management sim set in the world of Super Life. This game was born at the request of the fans in the official Discord Server. With this next entry on the horizon, I thought I could use some of my new art to make minor adjustments to 'Super Life RPG'!
 
Wishlist 'Super Life Franchise Lord' on steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828320/Super_Life_Franchise_Lord/

notes.title: 1.2 Back to the Ranch Update
notes.notes:
Highlighted Feature:
	• Added new town "Golden Springs"

New Features:
	• 10 new quest NPCs
	• New jobs
	• New school and gym
	• New mini game
	• New daily actions
	• New special events
	• New items
	• New secrets
	• New "Hunt"
	• Rebalanced level and task systems
	• Minor and major bug fixes
	• DOGS!

QoL Improvements:
	• Soft Reset - Reset your game without being level 100 and still keep your coins and prestige. 
	• Prestige - Now you can prestige each class 10 times
	• Added controller support (PC)
	• Added volume settings

Other notable changes:
	• All players start with $200 (Rich still get bonus $2K)
	• Grandpas Ranch updated to match ranch in Golden Springs
	• Coin Miners are now restricted to 10/Prestige However if you have over the limit your miners will NOT be reset
	• Space Blasters has received many small changes including 3 seconds of invulnerability after death
	• Bank in now locked until level 3
	• Reduced requirements to earn degrees
	• Mouse cursor size has been increased to help with controller gameplay
	• Coffee beans will now be consumed while you sleep if you own a coffee pot
	• Alcohol is no longer all created equal - some drinks will make you pass out sooner than others
	• Removed Adderall and Protein from gold boxes
	• 23 Hour fitness - increased STR gains after level 20
	• Home Gym has been buffed drastically
	• Most Jobs offer more XP and Careers now go up 2XP per promotion
	• Many food items now grant more XP

As you can see I have been very busy, I hope you all enjoy this large update! Expect to see many bug fixes and small content updates in the next few months!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

All Users: If you are under level 20 I recommend using the "Soft Reset" to get the new level stat requirements. The game has been rebalanced to play much faster so getting those levels back should not be an issue. 

Mac Users: I found a bug with the controller support that was crashing the Mac build. I have decided because 94% of players are on PC that I need to launch the update as is. I apologize to all Mac users but I will look into and try to get controller support on Mac in the future.

notes.title: 1.1.9 Meatball Plate Update
notes.notes:
That is all I added, a plate of meatballs at Mykea… seriously.

So why is this update 200MB?

I am glad you asked. I would like to formally announce I have begun working on a free expansion for Super Life (RPG)! Many new 3D models, textures and other art assets have already been added to this build for testing purposes. I will be announcing more info about this expansion on the Super Life discord channel in September! 

Version 1.1.9 also includes many small bug fixes.
